intervals.label: tritium beta-decay neutrino-mass measurements
intervals.note: Year precision, from the group's own 2015 status paper. The data set analysed in the final neutrino-mass paper (PRD 84, 112003) was 'acquired from 1994 to 2004'; the broader 1985-2005 range counts the whole measurement programme.
intervals.quote: The corresponding measurements were done from 1985 to 2005 [24, 25] and the final results of these efforts were published in [19].

intervals.label: keV sterile-neutrino search: first measurements and continued operation
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv v1 date of the paper reporting the first measurements (the measurements themselves are older, undated in the abstract). The interval is open because no source consulted says the measurements have stopped; the most recent dated evidence found is that 2017 paper (a conference abstract mentions a planned TRISTAN-Troitsk upgrade), so current operation on 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.
intervals.quote: We present the first measurements of tritium beta-decay spectrum in the electron energy range 16-18.6 keV.

name: Troitsk nu-mass windowless gaseous tritium source and electrostatic spectrometer

placements.note: Placed at the campus-grade INR Troitsk point; no source gives the hall.
placements.quote: The "Troitsk nu-mass" program is conducted by the Institute for Nuclear Research of the Russian Academy of Sciences.

energy_resolution.quote: The spectrometer allows one to get resolution of 3-4 eV

isotope.quote: The setup consists of a windowless gaseous tritium source and an electrostatic electron spectrometer.

summary.plain: A long pipe of tritium gas inside a strong magnetic field, with an electrostatic filter that passes only the highest-energy decay electrons to a detector.
summary.technical: Windowless gaseous tritium source (about 0.8 T, 5 T plugs) feeding an integrating electrostatic spectrometer with adiabatic magnetic collimation; resolution 3-4 eV.

technology.quote: an integrating electrostatic spectrometer with adiabatic magnetic collimation, and a windowless gaseous tritium source (WGTS)
technology.value: Windowless gaseous tritium source with an integrating electrostatic spectrometer with adiabatic magnetic collimation (MAC-E filter)
